high_level_description: stc brand style, an overhead view of three Saudi colleagues sitting around a round white table in a rose-lit office, gathered around a laptop.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A rose-toned carpeted office floor with a round white table, viewed from directly above.

elements.desc: Two men wearing white thobes and red-and-white checkered ghutras, seated at the table with one pointing at the laptop screen.
A third man seen from behind, seated between them, facing the laptop.
